description: Verify IDEA plugin build health, sync current-platform native binary, run gradle gates, report cross-platform gaps blocking JetBrains Marketplace publish.

steps.label: Build native binary for current platform into dist/
steps.command: cd /Users/forest/code/flutterguard && mkdir -p dist && V=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && OS=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') && case "$OS" in darwin) OS='macos';; linux) OS='linux';; *) echo 'UNSUPPORTED'; exit 1;; esac && ARCH=$(uname -m) && case "$ARCH" in arm64|aarch64) ARCH='arm64';; x86_64|amd64) ARCH='x64';; *) echo 'UNSUPPORTED'; exit 1;; esac && DIR="dist/flutterguard-${V}-${OS}-${ARCH}" && rm -rf "$DIR" && mkdir -p "$DIR" && dart compile exe bin/flutterguard.dart -o "$DIR/flutterguard" && chmod +x "$DIR/flutterguard" && "$DIR/flutterguard" --version && echo "BUILT: $DIR/flutterguard"

steps.label: Copy current-platform binary into idea-plugin/src/main/resources/bin/
steps.command: cd /Users/forest/code/flutterguard && V=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && OS=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') && case "$OS" in darwin) OS_PART='darwin';; linux) OS_PART='linux';; *) echo 'UNSUPPORTED'; exit 1;; esac && ARCH=$(uname -m) && case "$ARCH" in arm64|aarch64) ARCH_PART='arm64';; x86_64|amd64) ARCH_PART='x64';; *) echo 'UNSUPPORTED'; exit 1;; esac && SRC="dist/flutterguard-${V}-macos-${ARCH_PART}/flutterguard" && DST="idea-plugin/src/main/resources/bin/flutterguard-${OS_PART}-${ARCH_PART}" && mkdir -p idea-plugin/src/main/resources/bin && cp "$SRC" "$DST" && chmod +x "$DST" && file "$DST" && echo "SYNCED: $DST"
steps.expect: exit 0, file reports Mach-O or ELF

steps.label: Build plugin zip
steps.command: cd /Users/forest/code/flutterguard/idea-plugin && ./gradlew buildPlugin && ls -lh build/distributions/*.zip && shasum -a 256 build/distributions/*.zip

steps.label: Report missing platform binaries blocking publish
steps.command: cd /Users/forest/code/flutterguard && V=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && echo '=== CROSS-PLATFORM BINARY CHECKLIST ===' && echo "Version: $V" && echo '' && for target in "dist/flutterguard-${V}-macos-arm64/flutterguard" "dist/flutterguard-${V}-macos-x64/flutterguard" "dist/flutterguard-${V}-linux-x64/flutterguard" "dist/flutterguard-${V}-windows-x64/flutterguard.exe"; do if [[ -f "$target" ]]; then echo "  [x] $target"; else echo "  [ ] $target — NEEDS BUILD"; fi; done && echo '' && echo 'Build commands per platform:' && echo '  macOS arm64:  bash scripts/package_release.sh' && echo '  macOS x64:    bash scripts/package_release.sh' && echo '  Linux x64:    bash scripts/package_release.sh' && echo '  Windows x64:  powershell scripts/package_release.ps1' && echo '' && echo 'After all binaries collected under dist/:' && echo '  bash scripts/idea_plugin_preflight.sh' && echo '  bash scripts/idea_plugin_publish.sh'

post_execution_summary: After all 4 platform binaries are in dist/, run: bash scripts/idea_plugin_preflight.sh && bash scripts/idea_plugin_publish.sh. First-time publish also requires manual plugin listing creation at https://plugins.jetbrains.com/.
